description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure compliance with all regulatory standards. You will be instrumental in driving positive patient outcomes and maintaining high standards of clinical excellence.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, including staff management, policy implementation, and quality assurance initiatives. This position is ideal for a visionary leader with a passion for geriatric care and a commitment to continuous improvement. Join a team that values compassion, professionalism, and innovation in delivering top-tier healthcare services to our residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility.
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience and qualifications.

description:
Join a reputable medical center in Winslow, AZ, as a Labor & Delivery / MedSurg Registered Nurse (RN). This dynamic role offers an exciting opportunity to provide comprehensive care across Labor, Delivery, Recovery, Postpartum (LDRP) units, including nursery care, and to support the MedSurg department. We are seeking dedicated professionals ready to make a significant impact in a supportive healthcare environment.

This position comes with a competitive hourly rate, attractive shift differentials, and a generous sign-on bonus of up to $12,000, along with a relocation bonus of up to $6,000 for eligible candidates. We value commitment and offer a supportive setting where you can grow your skills and contribute to patient well-being. A two-year commitment is required to qualify for the bonuses.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience in Labor and Delivery, Recovery, and Postpartum (LDRP)
At least 6 months of MedSurg experience in a hospital setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, ranging from $43.68 to $62.44 per hour. Shift differentials include 8% for 3 PM - 11 PM, 16% for 11:01 PM - 7 AM, and 4% for weekend shifts (Friday 7 PM - Monday 7 AM). An up to $12,000 sign-on bonus and up to $6,000 relocation bonus are available, both paid after a 90-day probation period and requiring a 2-year commitment.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Occupational Therapist (OT) for a contract position in Medford, OR. This role offers a competitive rate of $55+/hr and an initial contract period from August 10, 2026, to June 7, 2027. Join a supportive educational environment focused on student success.
As an Occupational Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing students' fine motor, visual motor, sensory processing, and self-care skills. You will develop and implement individualized treatment plans (IEPs), collaborate with teachers and parents, and provide essential consultation to school staff to support student development.
This is an excellent opportunity for an OT looking for a stable contract with a clear start and end date, allowing you to make a significant impact on the lives of school-aged children. We are looking for a professional committed to fostering a positive and inclusive learning experience.
requirements: Master's or Doctorate degree in Occupational Therapy
Knowledge of federal and state special education laws
